comment: ETI January 1983 Waveform Multiplier (David Ward-Hunt), 4-page article; page 2 holds the complete circuit diagram and parts list, page 3 the overlays. Two boards reuse designators, so the modulation board is prefixed MOD-; one multiplier stage (R11-R15, PR11, PR12, D1) is drawn and repeated six times.
uncertain: Parts list says 39 100k resistors on the multiplier board but the drawing shows only R11-R15 per multiplier (33 total); a sixth per multiplier (R16-R66) may exist on the PCB but is not drawn
